survival_target.note: PFS_MONTHS is the follow-up axis for the concordance objective only. It is not a feature, and a censored patient is never an earlier event.

c_index_note: C-index is Harrell's concordance over comparable pairs of (PFS_MONTHS, PFS_STATUS). A censored patient is only ever the later member of a pair. Time and event are targets, never features.
note: Y=0 is censored at last follow-up, not lifelong disease-free confirmation. PFS months are not features.
